Title: Cognitive Services - New Computer Vision API v3.2 now generally available

Body.Content:
The Computer Vision API v3.2 is now generally available with the following updates:

  • Improved image tagging model: analyzes visual content and generates relevant tags based on objects, actions and content displayed in the image. This is available through the Tag Image API. See the Image Analysis how-to guide and overview to learn more.
  • Updated content moderation model: detects presence of adult content and provides flags to filter images containing adult, racy and gory visual content. This is available through the Analyze API. See the Image Analysis how-to guide and overview to learn more.
  • OCR (Read) available for 73 languages including Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Latin languages.
  • OCR (Read) also available as a Distroless container for on-premise deployment.

Learn more.
